verification.scope: Execution and contract checks; business ambiguities require operator answers

notes: Workbook has one visible sheet, 'Variants', with one 12-row product/variant table; no inventory, promotion, category or separate pricing tables were detected.
SKU is the only unique key. Product name, Parent style, Color and EU size repeat across variants, so they must not be treated as the identity.
Currency is explicitly PHP on every row; the target default THB should not be applied and no FX conversion should be performed.
Price list is explicitly 'standard' on every row. Tax included is explicitly No, and Tax rate is explicitly 5% on every row, giving vat_included=false and vat_rate=0.05 without inference.

Color and EU size should be exposed as attributes.color and attributes.size strings via attribute passthrough renaming; the target schema has no dedicated nested color/size pointers. Parent style can similarly be retained as an attribute so it is not lost.

No blocking source ambiguity was found for the classification: the sheet supplies explicit currency, unit, price-list, tax-inclusion and tax-rate values. Tax values in this synthetic fixture should not be published as current tax advice.

tables.reason: Single sheet with one row per variant SKU (SKU is unique across all 12 rows) and each row carries product name, variant attributes, sales unit, currency and one standard price list. The grain is product/variant, with price fields embedded rather than a separate pricing table.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header SKU, 12/12 unique values following STYLE-<n>-<COLOR>-<size> (e.g. STYLE-1-BLK-40); this is the variant identity. Preserve as text so no characters are lost.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header Product name; three distinct values, each repeated across four variant SKUs (SIM court shoe 1/2/3). This is the display name shared by the variants.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header Currency with constant value PHP on all 12 rows; explicit ISO code, so it overrides the schema default THB. Do not convert FX.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header Sales unit, constant PAIR on all rows; PAIR is a known sell unit in the target enum hint and matches the shoe variants.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header Price list, constant value 'standard' on every row; maps directly to the required price_list key, keeping the explicitly stated list name.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header Net price; 12 distinct numeric amounts from 1234.56 to 1356.77, one per SKU. Together with the single price list and Tax included=No this is the unit price amount for the standard list.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header Tax included with constant value No (12/12); explicit evidence that Net price is VAT-exclusive, so vat_included is false.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header Tax rate with constant '5%' (12/12); explicit source tax percentage. Convert to the numeric fraction 0.05 for vat_rate; the fixture value is not current tax advice.

columns.name: Parent style
columns.reason: Header Parent style; STYLE-1/2/3 each repeat across four variant SKUs. This is a style grouping attribute, not the record identity, so it should be retained in the open attributes object rather than used as /sku.

columns.name: Color
columns.reason: Header Color with BLK/WHT values. The operator explicitly requests this as attributes.color (string) while SKU remains the identity.

columns.name: EU size
columns.reason: Header EU size with integer values 40/41. The operator explicitly requests this as attributes.size (string), not a separate product identity.

changes_from_draft: /prices/*/price_list now reads the source column 'Price list' (explicit 'standard', 12/12) instead of a hard-coded constant — same value, but sourced and auditable.
/prices/*/vat_included now derives from the explicit 'Tax included' flag ('No' → false) instead of a constant false.
Added the missing /prices/*/vat_rate mapping from 'Tax rate' ('5%' → 0.05); the draft dropped this explicit source field and would have silently applied the schema default 0.07.
Currency mapped from the explicit 'Currency' column (PHP, 12/12) with upper/trim normalisation; no FX conversion; schema default THB is not applied.

Variant attributes exposed via SourceSpec.rename: 'Color' → color, 'EU size' → size, 'Parent style' → parent_style, kept through attributes_passthrough (the contract has no dedicated colour/size pointers).

Limitation: rename cannot change a value's type, so attributes.size is emitted as the number 40/41 rather than a string; the contract's /attributes accepts string|number|boolean|null, so no data is lost and no nested pointer was invented.
SKU is cast to string only (already text with dashes) — no zero-padding, stripping or numeric coercion.
Record dedupe set on the identity key /sku; /prices deduped on /price_list (one standard price per SKU).

No source evidence for pack_size, barcode, category, description, status, inventory or promotions — these are left unmapped rather than fabricated; /status keeps its declared schema default 'active' downstream.
Added quality rules: sku not_null+unique, product_name not_null, currency 3-letter pattern, price amount positive.
